title: OpenClaw automatic local model tool-calling selection
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$work='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $work|Out-Null;$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';if(-not(Test-Path $ep)){throw 'OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_ARTIFACT_MISSING'};$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$tags=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'/api/tags') -TimeoutSec 10;$models=@($tags.models|ForEach-Object{$_.name});if($models.Count -eq 0){throw 'NO_OLLAMA_MODELS'};Write-Output ('V432_057C_MODELS='+($models -join ','));$preferred=@('qwen2.5-coder:14b','qwen3:8b','deepseek-r1:14b','d89ftekb7/mistral-nemo-uncensored:12b-q4_0','dolphin-mistral:7b-v2.8-q4_K_M');$ordered=@();foreach($p in $preferred){if($models -contains $p){$ordered+=$p}};foreach($m in $models){if($ordered -notcontains $m){$ordered+=$m}};$winner=$null;$evidence=@();$i=0;foreach($m in $ordered){$i++;$target=Join-Path $work ('tool-probe-'+$i+'.txt');Remove-Item $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$prompt='Use your write tool to create exactly this local Windows file: '+$target+' with exactly this single line: TOOL_MODEL_OK . Actually call the tool; do not merely describe it. Then reply exactly TOOL_CALL_DONE';$out=& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key ('3en-057c-'+$i) --model ('ollama/'+$m) --message $prompt --json --timeout 120 2>&1;$code=$LASTEXITCODE;$raw=$out|Out-String;$ok=$false;if($code -eq 0 -and (Test-Path $target)){try{$c=(Get-Content $target -Raw).Trim();if($c -eq 'TOOL_MODEL_OK'){$ok=$true}}catch{}};$evidence+=[pscustomobject]@{model=$m;exit=$code;fileCreated=(Test-Path $target);pass=$ok};Write-Output ('MODEL_TEST '+$m+' PASS='+$ok);if($ok){$winner=$m;break}};$evPath=Join-Path $root '057c-model-tool-evidence.json';$evidence|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content $evPath -Encoding UTF8;if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($winner)){throw 'NO_LOCAL_MODEL_PASSED_TOOL_CALL'};$sel=Join-Path $root 'selected-tool-model.txt';$winner|Set-Content $sel -Encoding ASCII;Write-Output ('V432_057C_WINNER='+$winner)
